messages:
Marco Almeida: Hey team — Lighthouse Health sent the vendor security questionnaire back (SOC2/DPA + vendor risk). They want answers for KMS, data residency, and incident response by EOD Friday. Doc: https://redwood.share/lh-qna-2026 (preview shared). Can someone own the sections?

Tara Nguyen: I can take KMS + data residency. Will use our standard phrasing but double-check nuances for Dedicated vs Private.

Diego Ramos: I can draft incident response and escalation matrix. Quick question: they ask whether we "support BYOK and HSM" — what's the short official line we should put?

Marco Almeida: For now put the conservative answer and flag legal if they push. Suggested starter text (Tara/Diego feel free to edit):

```
We support customer-managed keys via cloud KMS integrations. BYOK is supported on Dedicated and Private deployments; HSM integrations are available for Private deployments via customer-managed partners or marketplace integrations.
```

Tara Nguyen: That wording looks fine. I'll tighten to our legal-approved variant and add the residency matrix (US/EU/APAC region options).

ops-bot: Reminder: Questionnaire deadline in 48 hours for ticket #CS-1142. Please update the doc and set status to "ready for legal" when done. :bell:

Diego Ramos: Working on IR section now. Draft snippet for the timeline:

- Detection: within minutes; mandatory alerts to customer by T+1 hour for incidents affecting data access or exfiltration.
- Containment & remediation: initial containment within 24 hours; follow-up report within 72 hours.
- Post-incident review: detailed RCA within 14 days.

I'll paste the full text in the doc in a few.

Marco Almeida: Action items: Tara = KMS + residency (upload by tomorrow midday). Diego = IR + monitoring answers (upload by tomorrow afternoon). Marco = final proofread and submit to Lighthouse, flag legal if they request BYOK/HSM audit details.

Tara Nguyen: Uploaded draft answers here: https://redwood.share/lh-qna-answers-draft (comments enabled). I left two items for legal: exact HSM partner names & any code-of-conduct clause.

Diego Ramos: IR draft uploaded and I added the sample contact list (ops@redwood + security@redwood).

Marco Almeida: Great. I'll run a quick pass after lunch and submit once legal clears the two flagged lines. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Tara Nguyen: If legal needs context, tag @legal (Julia) and link this thread. I can join a quick sync if they want to discuss.

ops-bot: Ticket #CS-1142 status updated to "in-review" by Marco Almeida.
